title: Training Note: Whole-Home Gas Usage Bonus on Residential Electricity Supply Loyalty Credits
content:
Training note, Residential Electricity Supply renewal loyalty credits.

**Q. What is the whole-home bonus?**
A. A flat addition to the renewal loyalty credit, tiered on the customer's recent gas usage. The therms on the customer's gas energy charge lines under Residential Natural Gas Supply whose billing cycle started less than twelve whole months before the posting date are added up; at 700 therms or more the high whole-home bonus of 10.00 USD is added, from 400 up to but not including 700 therms the mid whole-home bonus of 5.00 USD is added, and below 400 therms nothing is added.

**Q. Which gas lines are read?**
A. The gas energy charge lines on the customer's Residential Natural Gas Supply bill lines, by the start of their billing cycle. A line counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its billing cycle start from the posting date.

| Therms in the window | Whole-home bonus |
|---|---|
| 700 or more | 10.00 USD |
| 400 up to but not including 700 | 5.00 USD |
| below 400 | nothing |

**Q. Where are the boundaries?**
A. Exactly 700 therms earns 10.00 USD and 699 therms earns 5.00 USD; exactly 400 therms earns 5.00 USD and 399 therms earns nothing. A customer with no gas lines in the window earns nothing.
